div.div: وَاخِدٌ and ↓ وَخَّادٌ (S, L, K,) and ↓ وَخُودٌ (L, K) A camel going along, or that goes along, throwing out his legs like the ostrich: (S, L, K:) or, quickly: or, with wide steps. (L, K.) The second [which is an intensive or frequentative epithet] is also applied to an ostrich: and the third [which is intensive] to a she-camel. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
